bundle.shortDescription: A watcher, a record-keeper, a gentle reminder.
bundle.longDescription: Cairn is a small companion that keeps the ledger of what you just did — copies, screenshots, saves, and your own notes — and trickles them into your to-dos. Local-first, with built-in undo/redo. It links out to your other worlds. Choose your familiar: Cinder, Murk, or Vane.
